# Hotel Lisbon Baixa

## Permanent property facts

Hotel Lisbon Baixa is in Lisbon, Portugal, in the Europe region.
Facilities: Rooftop plunge pool; tile courtyard; Portuguese restaurant. Pool or water-facility hours: 08:00-20:00.
Parking: Partner garage; EUR 28 nightly. Transportation: Airport metro connection is nearby.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
